statement: You are given an integer array nums containing positive and negative values.
A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return the length of the longest subarray whose elements add up to 0, or 0 if there is none.

examples.explanation: [-2, 2, -8, 1, 7] at indices 1 to 5 adds up to 0 and is the longest such subarray.
[1, 2, -3] adds up to 0 and has length 3. [-3, 3] also sums to 0 but is shorter.
Every element is positive, so no subarray can add up to 0.
